g.text: End-to-End Operational Lifecycle: From Sensor Ping to Actionable Dispatch
A Concrete Train Journey Scenario: Train #12004 departs Kanpur Central (CNB) → Processed in <15ms → Dual Passenger & Controller Value Delivery
NDLS → CNB → LKO (440 KM) · ZERO-MOCK TESTED
Next Block: CNB → Unnao Jn (18 km)
"Delay of 22 min due to turnaround rake
deficit & track speed restriction at KM 1022"
Holding 6 min creates 0 conflict on line;
Gomti Exp absorbs delay via timetable slack.
Actual arrival at 12:20 (+20m delay) · Inside [19.6m, 40.9m] cone!
Receipt #1963 Graded: Absolute Error = 1.8 min (In-Band: YES)
WHY THIS WINS OVER GENERIC SLACK / NTES:

Legacy systems display static estimates that fail when network congestion compounds. RailTwin-X computes dynamic multi-horizon foresight, bounds it with conformal certainty, and provides dispatchers with quantified passenger-hour trade-offs.
